_comment: arlo LOM configuration for enterprise_ai_framework. The LOM is a gradient resolved in situ (SKILL.md §1), not a pinned model (invariant #4). This host had no ollama/llama-server, no sentence-transformers, and no local /v1 endpoint at setup, so the default is arlo's offline lexical floor. `embedder` is intentionally null; set it only if you provision a CPU embedder.

ladder.what: offline lexical floor — deterministic bag-of-words over the harvested cards (arlo.translate). No dependency, always available, weakest ranking, honestly labeled '[lexical match, no model]'.
the model running the arlo skill itself (the agent that invoked /arlo:start ranks cards directly, no embedder). This is the setup-time LOM and the strongest reader when the agent is up.
ladder.reachable_when: the coding agent / frontier is up (i.e. NOT the lights-out case, but the fast path when it is)

ladder.what: the platform's OWN gateway — vLLM/Forge serving an open model through this bundle's LiteLLM gateway. The customer's layer calling the customer's own providers is not phone-home (standing constraint). Reach it at the gateway origin recorded in bundle/.env.
ladder.reachable_when: the bundle (`make up`) or the k3s cluster is running

ladder.what: a CPU sentence-transformers embedder for better lexical ranking. Not installed here and not a default. Install `sentence-transformers`, then set `embedder` above to a model name (e.g. 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2'); arlo.cli auto-falls-back to the lexical floor if it is ever unreachable.

escalation_policy: Run the default (lexical floor). Escalate up the ladder only when a goal is a novel multi-step inference the distilled runbooks don't cover, or the top card scores below the confidence floor. The operator's budget decides how far to climb; abstain rather than guess if no rung is reachable.
invariant: arlo never emits a command that is not real ground truth. At worst it surfaces the wrong REAL command, always labeled with its confidence and alternatives.
